simple.meaning: אֱמוּנָה (ʼĕmûwnâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “literally firmness ; figuratively security ; morally fidelity.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 49 times across Exodus, Deuteronomy, 1 Samuel, 2 Kings, 1 Chronicles, and 8 more, beginning at Exodus 17:12. Its contexts include offering, righteousness, faith, priesthood.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אֱמוּנָה (H530).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.

definitions.short: literally firmness ; figuratively security ; morally fidelity
definitions.usage: faith(-ful, -ly, -ness, (man)), set office, stability, steady, truly, truth, verily.
definitions.full: H530. emunah אֱמוּנָה noun feminine firmness, steadfastness, fidelity Exod 17:12 46t.; אֱמוּנוֺת Prov 28:20 . 1 literally firmness, steadiness: Exod 17:12 א יָדָיו ׳וַיְהִי his hands were steadiness (i.e. steady). 2. stead-fastness , עִתֶּיךָ אֱמוּנַת steadfastness of thy times Isa 33:6 . 3. faithfulness, trust: a. of human conduct Psa 37:3 ; Prov 12:22 ; Jer 5:3 ; 7:28 ; 9:2 ; 2Kin 12:16 ; in office 22:7 ; 2Chr 19:9 ; 31:12 ; 34:12 ; ( על ) בֶּאֱמוּנָה in trust (over) 1Chr 9:22 , 26 , 31 ; 2Chr 31:15 , 18 ; א ׳דֶּרֶח Psa 119:30 ; אֱמוּנוֺת אִישׁ man of great faithfulness Prov 28:20 ; associated with צֶדֶק in human character א ׳יָפִיחַ צֶדֶק יַגִּיד who breatheth out faithfulness sheweth forth righteousness 12:17 ; compare1 Sam 26:23 ; Isa 59:4 ; Jer 5:1 ; יִחְיֶה בֶּאֱמוּנָתוֺ צַדִּיק a righteous man by his faithfulness liveth Hab 2:4 (> faith Luth AV RV). b. as a divine attribute Psa 88:12 ; 89:2 ; 89:3 ; 89:6 ; 89:9 ; Isa 25:1 ; Hosea 2:22 ; Lam 3:21 ; אֱמוּנָה אֵל Deut 32:4 ; his faithfulness is shewn in his works Psa 33:4 ; commands 119:86 ; in affliction 119:75 ; in his oath to David 89:50 . it reacheth unto the skies 36:6 ; unto all Generations 100:5 ; 119:90 ; he will not belie it 89:34 . It is אֹמֶן אֱמוּנָה Isa 25:1 ; compare מְאֹד אֱמוּנָה Psa 119:138 . It is closely associated with the divine חֶסֶד mercy 89:25 ; 92:3 ; 98:3 ; Hosea 2:22 ; with the divine צְדָקָה צדֶק, Psa 96:13 ; 143:1 ; Isa 11:5 ; & salvation Psa 40:11 .

occurrences.englishText: But Moses’ hands were heavy; so they took a stone, and put it under him, and he sat on it. Aaron and Hur held up his hands, the one on the one side, and the other on the other side. His hands were steady until sunset.
The Rock: his work is perfect,
Yahweh will render to every man his righteousness and his faithfulness; because Yahweh delivered you into my hand today, and I wouldn’t stretch out my hand against Yahweh’s anointed.
The money for the trespass offerings, and the money for the sin offerings was not brought into Yahweh’s house. It was the priests’.
However there was no accounting made with them of the money that was delivered into their hand; for they dealt faithfully.”

All these who were chosen to be gatekeepers in the thresholds were two hundred twelve. These were listed by genealogy in their villages, whom David and Samuel the seer ordained in their office of trust.
for the four chief gatekeepers, who were Levites, were in an office of trust, and were over the rooms and over the treasuries in God’s house.
Mattithiah, one of the Levites, who was the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, had the office of trust over the things that were baked in pans.
He commanded them, saying, “You shall do this in the fear of Yahweh, faithfully, and with a perfect heart.
They brought in the offerings, the tithes, and the dedicated things faithfully. Conaniah the Levite was ruler over them, and Shimei his brother was second.

Under him were Eden, Miniamin, Jeshua, Shemaiah, Amariah, and Shecaniah, in the cities of the priests, in their office of trust, to give to their brothers by divisions, to the great as well as to the small;

and those who were listed by genealogy of all their little ones, their wives, their sons, and their daughters, through all the congregation; for in their office of trust they sanctified themselves in holiness.

The men did the work faithfully. Their overseers were Jahath and Obadiah, the Levites, of the sons of Merari; and Zechariah and Meshullam, of the sons of the Kohathites, to give direction; and others of the Levites, who were all skillful with musical instruments.
For Yahweh’s word is right.
Your righteousness is like the mountains of God.
Trust in Yahweh, and do good.
Don’t withhold your tender mercies from me, Yahweh.
Are your wonders made known in the dark?
I indeed declare, “Love stands firm forever.
“I have made a covenant with my chosen one,
For who in the skies can be compared to Yahweh?
You rule the pride of the sea.
I will set his hand also on the sea,
I will not break my covenant,
Remember, Lord, the reproach of your servants,
with the ten-stringed lute, with the harp,
before Yahweh; for he comes,
He has remembered his loving kindness and his faithfulness toward the house of Israel.
For Yahweh is good.
I have chosen the way of truth.
Yahweh, I know that your judgments are righteous,
All of your commandments are faithful.
Your faithfulness is to all generations.
You have commanded your statutes in righteousness.
Hear my prayer, Yahweh.
He who is truthful testifies honestly,
Lying lips are an abomination to Yahweh,
A faithful man is rich with blessings;
Righteousness will be the belt of his waist,
Yahweh, you are my God. I will exalt you! I will praise your name, for you have done wonderful things, things planned long ago, in complete faithfulness and truth.
There will be stability in your times, abundance of salvation, wisdom, and knowledge.
No one sues in righteousness,

“Run back and forth through the streets of Jerusalem, and see now, and know, and seek in its wide places, if you can find a man, if there is anyone who does justly, who seeks truth, then I will pardon her.

O Yahweh, don’t your eyes look on truth? You have stricken them, but they were not grieved. You have consumed them, but they have refused to receive correction. They have made their faces harder than a rock. They have refused to return.
You shall tell them, ‘This is the nation that has not listened to Yahweh their God’s voice, nor received instruction. Truth has perished, and is cut off from their mouth.’
Oh that I had in the wilderness
They are new every morning.
and the earth will respond to the grain, and the new wine, and the oil;
Behold, his soul is puffed up. It is not upright in him, but the righteous will live by his faith.
